originalTitle: Remy Ma, Keke Wyatt - Why I Get Married?
content: The wedding was the dream. The marriage was something else. In the official video for “Why I Get Married?” featuring Keke Wyatt, Remy Ma takes us through a marriage in four stages: the dream, the darkness, the drowning and finally, the walk away. From a white wedding dress that turns black, to the loneliness behind closed doors, Remy explores the difference between the marriage everyone sees and the reality a woman may be living privately. As the relationship unravels, the imagery becomes more powerful; drowning, fire and ultimately walking away without looking back. Keke Wyatt’s powerhouse vocals bring another layer of soul and emotion to a record about love, relationships, growth and that private question so many women have asked themselves: “Why did I get married?” The lead single from Remy Ma’s upcoming project, Alimony, “Why I Get Married?” sets the tone for what’s to come.
chineseContent: 婚礼是梦想。婚姻是另一回事。在“我为什么结婚？”的官方视频中由科克·怀亚特 (Keke Wyatt) 主演的雷米·马 (Remy Ma) 带领我们经历了婚姻的四个阶段：梦想、黑暗、溺水，以及最后的走开。从白色婚纱变黑，到关起门来的孤独，雷米探索了每个人所看到的婚姻与一个女人可能私下生活的现实之间的差异。随着关系的解开，意象变得更加强大。溺水、火灾，最后头也不回地走开。 Keke Wyatt 强劲的歌声为这张关于爱情、人际关系、成长以及许多女性问自己的私人问题的唱片带来了另一层灵魂和情感：“我为什么结婚？”雷米·马 (Remy Ma) 即将推出的项目《赡养费》(Alimony) 的主打单曲《Why I Get Married?》为即将发生的事情定下基调。
